violated_contract: A device capability must be decided from what the device advertises, not from whether a read of it threw. The native BLE transport answers a characteristic the firmware does not expose with an empty read rather than an error, so OmiDeviceConnection.performHasPhotoStreamingCharacteristic reported a camera on every pendant, and CaptureController re-armed photo streaming on each reset, logging a photo-controller start and an image listener for a device with no camera. Data in the read is no test either: glass leaves the image characteristic empty until it has captured.
canonical_prevention: On NativeBleTransport, photo capability is NativeBleTransport.hasCharacteristic on the discovered GATT table, the check playToSpeakerHaptic already uses; other transports, which throw for an absent characteristic, keep the read. Tests drive a pendant that does not advertise the characteristic while every read returns data (no camera, nothing read), glass discovered as an omi device and glass that has not captured (both have a camera), and a throwing non-native transport.
